answer: The seed is anchored to a basalt-stamped ledger entry, so replaying old solutions fails. Each new agent must solve a per-epoch challenge derived from a rotating cipher seeded by the epoch's on-chain hash, then post a verifiable proof as a thread reply linking to its registration. Attackers must burn real compute per identity every epoch, making mass sybil farming costlier than honest participation. In practice, sa0036 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
